top_story.headline: Union PAC returned $20,863.51 it says was deposited in error, and FEC wants details
top_story.dek: FEC's October 7 letter to a sprinkler fitters' local union political committee questions a refund to the union itself.
paragraphs: The FEC's Reports Analysis Division sent a request for additional information to the political action committee tied to Road Sprinkler Fitters Local Union No. 669, U.A., AFL-CIO over its June monthly report. Schedule B shows $20,863.51 in disbursements to the union itself, described as a "Refund of contribution (deposit made in error)."

The letter notes that federal law bars unions from contributing to influence federal elections, apart from paying a connected committee's solicitation and administrative costs. It asks the committee to explain the transaction, give the date of the original deposit, and report the original receipt on Schedule A of an amended report.
Separately, Vote Rev PAC was asked about a reimbursement for "administrative expenses" to "Vote Rev," an apparently unregistered organization, which FEC says looks like an in-kind contribution.

sections.headline: Nine sitting members and delegates drew 14 FEC review letters, led by joint-fundraising omissions
paragraphs: Fourteen RFAIs landed on committees of Rep. Raja Krishnamoorthi, Sen. Katie Britt, Delegate Kimberlyn King-Hinds, Delegate James Moylan, Rep. Darrell Issa, Rep. Steve Scalise, Rep. Troy Carter, Rep. Ron Estes and Rep. Adriano Espaillat. Both Pacific delegates were told to disclose American Battleground Fund as a joint fundraising representative; the rest are routine bookkeeping questions.

Letter.

King-Hinds for Congress (Delegate Kimberlyn King-Hinds, R-MP) — October Quarterly 2025 (10/06): Transfers from American Battleground Fund look like joint-fundraising proceeds, but that committee is not listed as a joint fundraising representative on her Statement of Organization; she must amend it and file a memo Schedule A itemizing the committee's share of the gross contributions. Letter.

Letter.

Letter.
James Moylan for Congress (Delegate James Moylan, R-GU) — July Quarterly 2026 (10/06): Same American Battleground Fund joint-fundraising omissions repeated on the July quarterly report. Letter.

sections.headline: 44 campaign committees must fix reports, two over apparent unauthorized spending
paragraphs: These are letters to challengers, open-seat candidates and other candidate committees. Most are routine: excessive contributions, year-end cash mismatches, missing 48-hour notices and thin disbursement descriptions. The exceptions are James Osyf for Congress and Friends of Chris Bennett, where FEC flagged apparent improper use of committee funds, and a run of letters to Michael Farrell for Utah and Hoskins for IL 7. Letters dated 10/05 and 10/06 were not in earlier editions' record of reported filings.

Letter.

sections.headline: 29 PAC and party letters, including a union PAC's $20,863.51 refund to its own union
paragraphs: Letters to PACs, party committees and independent-expenditure groups. The standout is Road Sprinkler Fitters Local Union No. 669, U.A., AFL-CIO PAC, which returned $20,863.51 to the union as a deposit made in error. MAHA PAC drew three letters, and Indivisible Action and AB PAC were told their independent-expenditure dates do not match their 24- and 48-hour reports.

sections.headline: FEC challenges three new committee registrations, including a Greek political party name and a 'University of Alabama'
paragraphs: Three Statements of Organization drew the FEC's rare verification letter, which asks the treasurer to certify the Form 1 is true or withdraw it, and warns that the FEC may move the filings to its unverified database and refer false filings to law enforcement. The only red-flag keywords in today's batch were from this standard warning language, not allegations in themselves. All three have 11/09/2026 response dates.

items: 1776 America First Party, USA / Storm (10/05): Committee C00961946, Fort Bragg, California; treasurer John Wheeling. FEC asks him to confirm that the Form 1 is true, correct and complete or withdraw it. Letter.
University of Alabama (10/05): Committee C00958157, with a Truckee, California address; treasurer Jaleel Rashid Shabazz. Same demand to confirm or withdraw the Form 1. Letter.

Kirakos Mitsotakis Andreas Katsaniotis Nea Dimokratia Greece Soukou Skrekas Kedikoglou Simos (10/05): Committee C00962407, a Senate-type committee with a Karystos, South Evvia, Greece mailing address; treasurer listed as Kiriakos Mitsotakis. Same demand to confirm or withdraw the Form 1. Letter.

sections.headline: One new Form 99 notice: a PAC filed on paper when it must file electronically
paragraphs: Other Form 99 miscellaneous submissions in the window had already been reported in earlier editions, leaving one new non-termination Form 99.

items: Deliver Energize Succeed PAC (10/05): Notice of Paper Filing for its Form 1M multicandidate status notification, received 10/01; FEC says committees over the $50,000 threshold must file electronically. Treasurer Jen Slater also signs for Darrell Issa for Congress. Letter.
